text.ms:
1. (1) Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah Lalu Lintas

Jalan (Larangan Penggunaan Kenderaan Mikromobiliti Tertentu) 2021.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 17 Disember 2021.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Kaedah-Kaedah ini, melainkan jika konteksnya menghendaki makna yang

lain "kenderaan mikromobiliti tertentu" ertinya mana-mana kenderaan mikromobiliti

yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual yang memenuhi perihalan yang dinyatakan

dalam ruang (2) Jadual.

Larangan

3. (1) Mana-mana orang dilarang daripada menggunakan kenderaan

mikromobiliti tertentu di atas mana-mana bahagian mana-mana jalan.

(2) Walau apa pun subkaedah (1), Menteri boleh, setelah berunding dengan

pihak berkuasa yang berkenaan, mengecualikan pemakaian Kaedah-Kaedah ini

di mana-mana jalan atau mana-mana bahagian jalan tertakluk kepada apa-apa syarat

yang ditentukan oleh Menteri.

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRAFFIC

(PROHIBITION OF USE OF CERTAIN MICROMOBILITY VEHICLES) RULES 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 88(1)(c) and subsection 88(4)

of the Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister, after consultation with

the Minister charged with the responsibility for works, makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Road Traffic

(Prohibition of Use of Certain Micromobility Vehicles) Rules 2021.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 17 December 2021.

Definition

2. In these Rules, unless the context otherwise requires "certain micromobility

vehicles" means any micromobility vehicles that is specified in column (1) of the Schedule

that fulfils the description specified in column (2) of the Schedule.

Prohibition

3. (1) Any person is prohibited from the use of certain micromobility vehicle

on any part of any road.

(2) Notwithstanding subrule (1), the Minister may, after consultation with

the appropriate authority, exempt the application of this Rules on any road or any part

of the road subject to any conditions as the Minister may determine.
